tie_breaker_policy: Correctness always breaks deadlocks. Vetoes flow automatically on structural safety violations.

precedence_rules.simplicity_vs_structure: Evaluated on import-degree of affected symbol. High degree triggers Structure wins; Leaf node triggers Simplicity wins.
precedence_rules.frugality_vs_dryness: Evaluated on occurrence counters. Under 3 matches triggers Frugality wins (YAGNI). Third match triggers Dryness wins (Consolidate).
precedence_rules.convention_vs_explicit: Triggered on discovery patterns. Stable match found across 3+ sites triggers Convention wins.
precedence_rules.do_it_once_vs_novel: Triggered on mechanical pattern matching. Preconditions matched triggers reuse.
